title: Control wrap behavior for text (`st.markdown`, `st.text`, ...)
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Today, text created with `st.markdown` or other commands always wraps to new lines. This can be annoying in tight layouts. It would be good to add a parameter to not wrap to new lines in those cases but rather ellipsize the text (i.e. cut it and add `...`). ### Why? E.g. if you have this at the top of a dashboard, if you make the window smaller, it might look better to ellipsize the text instead of making a widget wrap to the next line or wrapping the text: ### How? Maybe simply `wrap=True|False`. Or something like `ellipsize`? See also some related considerations in #12582. Note that `st.code` also has a parameter `wrap_lines`. ### Additional Context Related: - #12582
